sd_too_many: More than 8 tiles on this page: the satellite does not show this one
sd_hint: Click a tile to edit it, or a free cell to add one.
sd_no_satellites: Add a satellite on the tab Satellites first.
sd_how: Click a free cell to add a tile, drag a tile to move it. The preview shows the current values; the colours of the satellite may differ a little.
sd_disabled_count: %s inactive tile(s) on this page are not shown.
sd_bad_size: This kind does not come in this size, the tile is left out: choose another size, or make room on the page.
sd_need_target: A thermostat needs the state of its target temperature, the tile is left out until it has one.
sd_swap: Drop to swap the two tiles
sd_no_swap: These two tiles do not fit into each other's place
sd_no_room: No free place for a copy of this size on the pages
sd_copy_replace: %s tiles on that page are replaced.
sd_preview_hint: Shows the tiles of this satellite as they are here, without saving. The saved tiles come back with "End preview", after saving, or after 10 minutes.
sd_preview_shown: The satellite shows the %s tiles of the editor.
sd_preview_waiting: Preview of %s tiles: the satellite is not connected, it gets them when it connects.
sd_preview_ended: The satellite shows the saved tiles again.
sd_preview_no_adapter: The adapter does not answer: start the instance (it must be running for the preview).
sd_preview_not_saved: Save the settings first: the adapter only knows the satellites of the saved settings.
sd_hint_missing: A state of this tile does not exist.
sd_hint_read_only: This state is read-only: a touch on the tile does not switch it.
sd_hint_not_number: This tile shows numbers, but the state is no number.
sd_icon_only: Only the icon (instead of the name)
sd_bg_state: State for the background (on = colour below, or a colour #RRGGBB)
sd_hide_toggle: The whole tile switches (without the toggle)
sd_orphan_hint: "%s" is no longer a satellite or tablet of the settings (renamed or removed), so its %s tile(s) show nowhere. Move them to a display, or delete them.
sd_links_hint: Point the camera of the tablet at its code, or open its link there, and add the page to the home screen. Save the settings first.
sd_links_not_running: The web app does not run: switch it on, enter a tablet and save (or see the log).
sd_links_renew_text: The old link stops working at once, also on the tablet itself and on its home screen. Open the new link (or its QR code) on the tablet afterwards. Use it when the link got into wrong hands or the tablet is given away.
